Name: Starry Void Frogs
Author: ColourRevival
Description:
Designed to look similar to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10116]Soft's Void Chicken Recolor[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24430](CP) Space Themed Void Eggs[/url].
The height is 15, so if you want to replace any other frogs, you can just copy the section between square brackets and add or subtract 15 from the Y value. Prismatic frogs that get their sprites replaced will still have a prismatic effect over the starry base.

Downloads.Description: Fixed the image size, looks like the uploaded file was doubled. Everything should work without any adjusting now!
